item.text: The source confirms three causes: the gateway creates a new identity and retries internally; policy always returns 50 ms, ignoring the profile; and checkout never passes its remaining budget to the gateway. I’ll put retries solely in checkout, preserve the operation ID, and cap each attempt by the deadline. I’m allowing up to five repair iterations; scanner and incident-memory tools are unavailable, so verification will use source review and the simulator.
